d.ko: Scavland is a hardcore Top-Down Pixel Art survival RPG set in a Post-Apocalyptic Soviet world. Scavenge the wastes and forgotten bunkers, take dangerous jobs, build your reputation, and customize your arsenal as you fight to survive mutants, hostile survivors, radiation, and the deadly Mist.
d.en: Scavland is a hardcore Top-Down Pixel Art survival RPG set in a Post-Apocalyptic Soviet world. Scavenge the wastes and forgotten bunkers, take dangerous jobs, build your reputation, and customize your arsenal as you fight to survive mutants, hostile survivors, radiation, and the deadly Mist.
d.zh: 《Scavland》是一款以苏联末世为背景的硬核俯视角像素生存 RPG。探索荒野与被遗忘的地堡 ，接受危险委托，积累声望并自定义你的武器装备。在变异体、敌对幸存者、辐射与致命迷雾的威胁下，想尽办法活下去。
